advice_en: Paracetamol at normal doses is generally safe for driving when you feel well.
advice_ha: Paracetamol a ƙima na yau da kullum yana da aminci don tafiya idan kana da lafiya.
advice_yo: Paracetamol ni iye ti o tọ yẹ fun wakọ nigbati o ba wa daradara.
advice_ig: Paracetamol na oke nke ọma dị mma maka ịkwọ ụgbọ ala mgbe ị nọ mma.

advice_en: Ibuprofen rarely affects alertness at standard doses. Stop driving if you feel dizzy.
advice_ha: Ibuprofen ba ya shafar hankali sosai a ƙima na yau da kullum. Ka daina tafiya idan ka ji jijjiga.
advice_yo: Ibuprofen ko pọ si iṣẹlẹ ni iye ti o tọ. Duro lati wakọ ti o ba ni aifọwọyi.
advice_ig: Ibuprofen adịghị emetụta ịtụnanya na oke nke ọma. Kwụsị ịkwọ ụgbọ ala ma ị na-atụ ụzọ.

advice_en: Metformin alone usually does not impair driving. Monitor for low blood sugar symptoms.
advice_ha: Metformin kadai ba ya shafar tafiya. Ka lura da alamun ƙaramin sukari a jini.
advice_yo: Metformin nikan ko pọ si wakọ. Ṣe akiyesi awọn ami aito sugar ninu ẹjẹ.
advice_ig: Metformin naanị adịghị emebi ịkwọ ụgbọ ala. Lelee akara sugar dị ala.

advice_en: Many antihistamines cause drowsiness. Avoid driving until you know how you react.
advice_ha: Antihistamines da yawa suna haifar da barci. Ka guji tafiya har ka san yadda jikinka ke amsawa.
advice_yo: Antihistamines pupọ n fa oorun. Yago fun wakọ titi ti o ba mọ bawo ni ara rẹ n dahun.
advice_ig: Antihistamines dị iche iche na-akpata ụra. Zere ịkwọ ụgbọ ala ruo mgbe ị ma otú gị si aghọta.

advice_en: Codeine and opioid cough syrups slow reactions and cause drowsiness. Do not drive.
advice_ha: Codeine da shiruwan tari na rage sauri kuma suna haifar da barci. Kada ka tafi tafiya.
advice_yo: Codeine ati cough syrup opioid n dinku esi ati fa oorun. Maṣe wakọ.
advice_ig: Codeine na cough syrup opioid na-eme ka ị laghachi na-akpata ụra. Ekwela ịkwọ ụgbọ ala.

advice_en: Tramadol is a strong painkiller that impairs concentration. Avoid driving completely.
advice_ha: Tramadol magani ne mai ƙarfi wanda ke shafar hankali. Ka guji tafiya gaba ɗaya.
advice_yo: Tramadol jẹ agun painkiller ti o ba concentration. Yago fun wakọ patapata.
advice_ig: Tramadol bụ painkiller siri ike na-emebi iche nche. Zere ịkwọ ụgbọ ala kpamkpam.

advice_en: Diazepam and similar sedatives strongly affect alertness. Never drive after taking them.
advice_ha: Diazepam da magungunan barci masu kama da shi suna shafar hankali sosai. Kada ka tafi tafiya bayan shan su.
advice_yo: Diazepam ati sedatives bẹẹ lọ n fa aifọwọyi. Maṣe wakọ lẹhin gbigba wọn.
advice_ig: Diazepam na sedatives yiri ya na-emebi ịtụnanya. Ekwela ịkwọ ụgbọ ala mgbe ị gwụsịrị ya.

advice_en: Any alcohol before driving is unsafe and illegal under FRSC rules. Use a designated driver.
advice_ha: Duk wani giya kafin tafiya ba ta da aminci kuma haram ce bisa dokokin FRSC. Yi amfani da direba da aka zaɓa.
advice_yo: Eyin oti kankan ṣaaju wakọ ko lewu ati ko ofin FRSC. Lo oluwakọ ti a yan.
advice_ig: Alcohol ọ bụla tupu ịkwọ ụgbọ ala adịghị mma ma bụ iwu FRSC. Jiri onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahọpụtara.

advice_en: Common antibiotics like amoxicillin usually do not affect driving unless you feel unwell.
advice_ha: Antibiotics kamar amoxicillin ba su shafar tafiya sai dai idan ba ka ji da lafiya ba.
advice_yo: Antibiotics bii amoxicillin ko pọ si wakọ yala o ba wa daradara.
advice_ig: Antibiotics dị ka amoxicillin adịghị emetụta ịkwọ ụgbọ ala ma ọ bụrụ na ị adịghị mma.

advice_en: Blood pressure medicines can cause dizziness when starting or changing dose. Drive cautiously.
advice_ha: Magungunan hawan jini na iya haifar da jijjiga a farkon amfani. Ka tafi tafiya a hankali.
advice_yo: Oogun blood pressure le fa aifọwọyi ni ibẹrẹ. Wakọ ni akiyesi.
advice_ig: Ọgwụ blood pressure nwere ike ime ka ị tụ ụzọ na mmalite. Kpachara anya ịkwọ ụgbọ ala.

advice_en: Some cough syrups contain sedating ingredients. Read the label and avoid driving if drowsy.
advice_ha: Wasu shiruwan tari suna da abubuwan da ke sa barci. Ka karanta lakabi kuma ka guji tafiya idan ka ji barci.
advice_yo: Awọn cough syrup kan ni awọn ohun elo ti o fa oorun. Ka akọwe aami ati yago fun wakọ ti o ba ni oorun.
advice_ig: Cough syrup ụfọdụ nwere ihe na-akpata ụra. Gụọ label ma zere ịkwọ ụgbọ ala ma ị na-arahụ ụra.

advice_en: Malaria treatment can cause weakness or dizziness. Rest and avoid driving until recovered.
advice_ha: Magani na malaria na iya haifar da rauni ko jijjiga. Ka huta kuma ka guji tafiya har ka farfado.
advice_yo: Itọju malaria le fa agbara tabi aifọwọyi. Sinmi ati yago fun wakọ titi ti o ba san.
advice_ig: Ịgwọ malaria nwere ike ime ka ị dị adịghị ike ma ọ bụ tụ ụzọ. Zuru ike ma zere ịkwọ ụgbọ ala ruo mgbe ị dịla mma.
